summary: Iteration 5 tests SAHAYSETU new modules (Survivors/Volunteers/Teams/Resources/Requests/Shelters/Messages/Alerts/Reports/Analytics/Profile). Backend: 33/33 pytest cases green - all new endpoints return correct shape (survivors {items,counts}, teams enriched with leader/team_status/current_mission/resources, resources with available/allocated/status + category filter, requests CRUD w/ Pending -> Approved advance, shelters with medical/food/water, conversations + POST message persists, alerts + PATCH status, reports list, analytics ?range=7d returns 8 datasets, profile GET/PATCH persists phone/organization/location via GET verification). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Clicking 'Add Survivor' on Survivors screen crashes with React 'Element type is invalid ... got: undefined. Check the render method of Survivors.' Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(app)/survivors.tsx imports SelectMenu from @/src/components/ui but SelectMenu is NOT exported from /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (only Logo/Button/Input/Card/SeverityPill/Avatar/ComingSoon/StatusBadge/StatCard are exported). Same import exists in /app/frontend/app/(app)/requests.tsx (New Request modal will also crash). Because of this crash the Add Survivor / New Request end-to-end flows could not be exercised.

rca_of_issue: Runtime error: 'Element type is invalid: expected a string ... but got: undefined. Check the render method of `Survivors`.' Reproduction: login as arjun@sahaysetu.in / rescue123, click sidebar nav-survivors, click 'Add Survivor'. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/(app)/survivors.tsx line 8 imports { Card, StatCard, StatusBadge, Button, Input, SelectMenu } from '@/src/components/ui', but /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx exports Logo, Button, Input, Card, SeverityPill, Avatar, ComingSoon, StatusBadge, StatCard - NOT SelectMenu. So SelectMenu resolves to undefined, and when the modal renders <SelectMenu .../> (lines 93,94) React throws. The same import pattern exists in /app/frontend/app/(app)/requests.tsx (lines 69,72). Mitigation: add and export a SelectMenu component (dropdown/press-to-open menu that reads value + options + onChange) from /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (or from a new module and re-export from ui.tsx). No backend change needed - backend already accepts the fields the modal defaults to (emergency_type='Flood', priority='High' for survivors; resource_type='Drinking Water', priority='High' for requests).
